brief: Make the statistics helpers correct and covered before anything else is built on them: the mean is wrong on empty input and the median is not implemented, and neither has tests.

beads.title: Fix Mean on an empty slice
beads.description: Mean divides by len(xs) without checking for zero, so it panics on an empty slice. Return 0 and a false ok flag instead, and keep the existing signature for callers.
beads.acceptance: Mean(nil) and Mean([]float64{}) return (0, false); every existing caller still compiles; go test ./... passes.

beads.title: Implement Median
beads.description: Median is a stub returning 0 with a TODO. Sort a copy of the input and average the two middle values on an even length.
beads.acceptance: Median returns the middle value for odd lengths and the mean of the two middle values for even ones; the input slice is not reordered; the TODO is gone.

beads.title: Cover the statistics helpers with table tests
beads.acceptance: A table-driven test covers empty, single-element, odd and even inputs for both Mean and Median, and fails if either regresses.
